task: Ground factual claims for the structure governance audit work.
output_summary: Root folder classes, local-only folder rules, deterministic structure audit tooling, workspace monitor document coverage, and related governance docs were added or updated.

evidence.reliability: Tracked self-documenting config defining root folder classes, reserved operational folders, local-only folders, generated outputs, and audit command.
Tracked deterministic tool for auditing root folder classifications and registered project README coverage.
Unit tests verified clean structure, unknown root folder gap, and missing README gap.
Command returned status clean with no gaps for the current repository root.
Tracked gitignore now marks local-only and generated-output paths.
Tracked collector includes workspace-doc and philosophy document categories.
Tracked validation record for audit, tests, config, memory, monitor, maps, grounding, and evaluation.
Google software engineering book chapter used for monorepo context and tooling trade-offs.
Official GitLab documentation used for repository path ownership and responsibility reference.
Official GitLab documentation used for source-vs-generated documentation separation reference.

claims.statement: The repository now has a root structure policy that separates registered projects, reserved operational folders, local-only folders, and generated outputs.
The structure-audit tool detects unregistered root folders and registered projects missing README files.
The current repository root structure passed the structure audit.
_private and outputs are now treated as local-only ignored folders, while durable artifacts belong under owning project folders.
Workspace Monitor now collects _docs and _philosophy documents as additional categories.
verification_steps: Checked collect-workspace.mjs and ran npm run collect/build.

claims.statement: The structural approach was informed by monorepo ownership and docs-as-code separation references.
verification_steps: Checked the external sources and recorded them in the web search record.

uncertainty_notes: A future multi-user collaboration model may justify CODEOWNERS or a richer owner map, but current repository scale does not require it.
No registered project was moved because that would require a separate migration plan and broader validation.
limitation_notes: The audit validates first-level root folder classification and project README presence; it does not inspect every nested folder.
The audit is policy-based and should be updated when new root folder classes become legitimate.
